title: ClearFront: close replacement undo hidden-information exploit
description: Implement approved PROMO-0010/INS-0025 in the editable app only: replacement must reveal its new card without leaving a reversible snapshot; preserve ordinary one-step undo for reversible actions. No refactor, balance, source, or baseline changes.
acceptance_criteria: After the player replaces a card and sees the drawn replacement, Undo is unavailable and cannot restore the pre-replacement hand.
At least one ordinary reversible action still creates a working one-step undo snapshot.
Replacement still discards one card, draws one card when available, does not increment cardsPlayed, and remains limited to once per turn.
Source and baseline remain byte-unchanged; the app remains file:// compatible and focused browser/static regression evidence is recorded.
Only app/index.html and task-specific test evidence are modified; no decomposition, rules, or balance change is mixed into this task.
